name: Data
description: Pretraining corpora, post-training/SFT/RL datasets and the curation tooling that builds them.

name: Pretraining
description: Frameworks and codebases for training base models at scale (parallelism, kernels, recipes).

name: Post-training
description: Fine-tuning, preference optimization and reinforcement-learning libraries that turn base models into assistants and agents.

name: Environments
description: RL and agent environments, environment libraries and hubs that supply tasks plus verifiable rewards.

name: Evals & benchmarks
description: Evaluation frameworks and the benchmarks used to compare models, harnesses and systems.

name: Inference
description: Serving engines and local runtimes that execute open-weight models efficiently.

name: Open-weight models
description: Model families whose weights are publicly downloadable, with their licenses and reported results.

name: Agent harnesses
description: Coding and general agent scaffolds/CLIs that wrap a model with tools, memory and a control loop.

name: Multi-agent & orchestration
description: Frameworks and protocols for composing several agents or tools into larger systems.

name: Apps & UX
description: End-user chat apps and desktop/web front-ends for running and using open models.

name: Safety & security
description: Guardrails, safety classifiers, red-teaming scanners and security evaluation tools.
